questions.q_en: The numerical taxonomy of plants is based on which of the following?
questions.solution_en: Numerical Taxonomy is the technique of classifying organisms using numerical methods. This method firmly clarifies as well as displays the degree of link among the species. Organisms are classified into taxa according to their similarities and differences. Numerical Taxonomy is at present a very essential part of current systematics. Numerical Taxonomy is also known as Taximetrics; however, presently it is more commonly referred to as Phenetics. It is the Numerical evaluation of the similarities or affinities of taxonomic units, which are typically classified into taxa based on their affinities.
questions.solution_hi: संख्यात्मक वर्गीकरण जीवों को संख्यात्मक विधियों का उपयोग करके वर्गीकृत करने की तकनीक है। यह विधि प्रजातियों के बीच संबंध की डिग्री को स्पष्ट व प्रदर्शित करती है। जीवों को उनकी समानताओं व असमानताओं के अनुसार वर्गों में वर्गीकृत किया जाता है। संख्यात्मक वर्गीकरण वर्तमान व्यवस्थितिकी का एक अत्यंत आवश्यक भाग है।

questions.q_en: Which of the following is related to neem?
questions.solution_en: Neem leaves are pinnately compound, meaning they have multiple leaflets arranged along both sides of a central stalk (rachis). This arrangement is common in plants like neem, rose, and tamarind.
questions.solution_hi: नीम की पत्तियाँ पिच्छाकार संयुक्त (pinnately compound) होती हैं, अर्थात इनमें एक केंद्रीय डंठल (रैचिस) के दोनों ओर कई छोटी पत्तियाँ व्यवस्थित होती हैं। यह व्यवस्था नीम, गुलाब व इमली जैसे पौधों में सामान्य है।

questions.q_en: Which among the following are called the amphibians of the plant kingdom?
questions.solution_en: Bryophytes are called the amphibians of the plant kingdom. Which include ferns and their relatives, share characteristics that enable them to adapt to both aquatic and terrestrial environments, much like amphibians in the animal kingdom.
questions.solution_hi: ब्रायोफाइट्स को पादप जगत के उभयचर कहा जाता है। इनमें फर्न व उनके संबंधी शामिल हैं, जो ऐसी विशेषताएँ साझा करते हैं जो उन्हें जलीय व स्थलीय दोनों वातावरणों में अनुकूलित होने में सक्षम बनाती हैं, जैसे प्राणी जगत में उभयचर।

questions.q_en: Which of the following is NOT a component of a flower?
questions.solution_en: A flower consists of four main parts - Calyx (sepals), Corolla (petals), Androecium (male reproductive part), and Gynoecium (female reproductive part). Spines are modified leaves or stem structures found in some plants for defense but are not a floral component.
questions.solution_hi: किसी फूल में चार मुख्य भाग होते हैं - बाह्यदलपुंज (Calyx), दलपुंज (Corolla), पुमंग (Androecium, नर प्रजनन भाग), व जायांग (Gynoecium, मादा प्रजनन भाग)। काँटे कुछ पौधों में सुरक्षा हेतु रूपांतरित पत्तियाँ या तना संरचनाएँ हैं परंतु ये पुष्पीय घटक नहीं हैं।

questions.q_en: ______ Plants that do not have well-differentiated body design fall in this group. The plants in this group are commonly called algae. These plants are predominantly aquatic.
questions.solution_en: Thallophyta consists of plants that do not have a well-differentiated body structure. The plants in this group are commonly called algae. These plants are predominantly aquatic.

questions.q_en: Which of the following is NOT related to reticulate venation?
questions.solution_en:
Venation refers to the pattern of veins in leaves:

• Reticulate venation (net-like structure) is found in dicots (e.g., China rose, Tulsi, Coriander).

• Parallel venation (parallel veins) is found in monocots (e.g., Maize, Grass, Banana).

Thus, Maize does not have reticulate venation.

questions.q_en: Who explained the structure and reproductive system of algae in 1935?
questions.solution_en: F.E. Fritsch (1935, 1945) in his book "The Structure and Reproduction of the Algae" proposed a system of classification of algae. He treated algae giving rank of division and divided it into 11 classes. His classification of algae is mainly based upon characters of pigments, flagella and reserve food material.
questions.solution_hi: एफ.ई. फ्रिट्श (1935, 1945) ने अपनी पुस्तक "द स्ट्रक्चर एंड रिप्रोडक्शन ऑफ द अल्गी" में शैवाल के वर्गीकरण की एक प्रणाली प्रस्तावित की। उन्होंने शैवाल को विभाग का दर्जा देकर इसे 11 वर्गों में विभाजित किया। उनका शैवाल वर्गीकरण मुख्यतः वर्णक, कशाभिका व संचित भोजन पदार्थ की विशेषताओं पर आधारित था।

questions.q_en: One of the _____, the giant redwood tree Sequoia is one of the tallest tree species.
questions.solution_en: The giant redwood, scientifically known as Sequoia, holds the title for the world's tallest tree among gymnosperms.

questions.q_en: In respect of classification of algae, the members of Phaeophyceae are commonly called:
questions.solution_en: In the classification of algae, the members of Phaeophyceae are commonly called "brown algae." Brown algae are a group of photosynthetic organisms found primarily in marine environments. They are characterized by their brown color, Brown algae can vary in size from small filamentous forms to large and complex seaweeds.

questions.q_en:
Which of the following statements best defines monoecious?

Options:
options_en: A flower with both androecium and gynoecium
questions.solution_en:
1 Definition of Monoecious:

o A monoecious plant or flower has both male reproductive structures (androecium) and female reproductive structures (gynoecium) within the same individual plant.

o This allows the plant to self-pollinate or cross-pollinate.

2) Examples:

o Plants like maize and cucurbits (e.g., pumpkins, squash) are monoecious.

3) Incorrect Options:

o Option 2 (Dithecous anther): Refers to an anther with two lobes, unrelated to monoecy.

o Option 3 (Gynoecium only): Refers to a unisexual female flower.

o Option 4 (Androecium only): Refers to a unisexual male flower.
